description: For every finite propositional context \(\Gamma\) and formula \(A\), \(\Gamma\) derives \(A\) in the chosen classical natural-deduction calculus if and only if \(\Gamma\) semantically entails \(A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.derives_iff_entails.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives Γ A ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Entails Γ A
